title: Natural affine ordinary tensor homology coordinates for quasi-coherent coefficients
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and M,N quasi-coherent O_Y-modules [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For each affine open U choose modules MA_U,NA_U over A_U=Gamma(Y,U), A_U-linear equivalences sM_U:MA_U -> Gamma(U,M), sN_U:NA_U -> Gamma(U,N), and a projective resolution P_U of MA_U (a nonnegative complex of projective modules with exact augmentation to MA_U). Let q:K -> M[0] be a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] and K K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], with no boundedness assumption. Put H=H^{-n}(Tot(K tensor N[0])) for n>=0 [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology]. There exist A_U-linear equivalences c_U:H_n(P_U tensor NA_U) -> Gamma(U,H). For a basic inclusion V subset U with restriction phi:A_U -> A_V, a phi-semilinear map b:NA_U -> NA_V, a chain map a:P_U -> Res_phi(P_V), and a tensor chain map k:(P_U tensor NA_U) -> Res_phi(P_V tensor NA_V), assume sM_V(pi_V a_0 x)=res_M(sM_U(pi_U x)), sN_V(b y)=res_N(sN_U y), and k_j(x tensor y)=a_j(x) tensor b(y). Then res_H(c_U x)=c_V(e(H_n(k)(x))) for all x, where e is the exact restriction-of-scalars homology comparison. This is an ordinary complex comparison, with no derived tensor object, closed immersion, quotient coefficient or existence of lifts.

proof.text: Apply CochainComplex.exists_isKFlatResolution to N[0], obtaining F, s, K-flatness and a quasi-isomorphism. This witness is used only in the theorem proof. Discard the unused termwise flatness and epimorphism conclusions.

For each U take the existing, explicitly constructed tensorResolutionCoordinateSections for P_U, K and F. Apply tensorResolutionCoordinateSections_naturality to the supplied b,a,k and ha,hb,hk. Its fixed-coordinate equation is exactly the required restriction equation. The proof does not need comparison witnesses, their existence or homotopy independence.

theorem exists_qcoh_ordinary_tensor_resolution_coordinates
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (MA NA : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, ModuleCat.{u} (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u))
    (sM : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, MA U ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)] M.val.obj (op U.1))
    (sN : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, NA U ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)] N.val.obj (op U.1))
    (P : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, ProjectiveResolution (MA U))
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (q : K ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M)
    (hK : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) K) (hq : QuasiIso q) (n : ℕ) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory Y.sheaf
    let S := CochainComplex.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let Q := (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K (S.obj N)
      (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))).homology
        (-(n : ℤ))
    ∃ c : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
        ((((tensorRight (NA U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj
          (P U).complex).homology n) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)] Q.val.obj (op U.1),
      ∀ (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
        (_hbasic : ∃ f : Γ(Y, U.1), Y.basicOpen f = V.1),
        let φ := (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
        let TA := (tensorRight (NA U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)
        let TC := (tensorRight (NA V)).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)
        ∀ (b : NA U →ₛₗ[φ] NA V)
          (a : (P U).complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.down ℕ)).obj (P V).complex)
          (k : TA.obj (P U).complex ⟶
            ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj
              (TC.obj (P V).complex)),
          (∀ x : (P U).complex.X 0,
            sM V ((P V).π.f 0 (a.f 0 x)) =
              M.val.map (homOfLE h).op (sM U ((P U).π.f 0 x))) →
          (∀ y : NA U, sN V (b y) = N.val.map (homOfLE h).op (sN U y)) →
          (∀ (j : ℕ) (x : (P U).complex.X j) (y : NA U),
            k.f j (x ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, U.1)] y) =
              (show (P V).complex.X j from a.f j x) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, V.1)] (b y)) →
          let e := ((TC.obj (P V).complex).sc n).mapHomologyIso
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ)
          ∀ x, Q.val.map (homOfLE h).op (c U x) =
            c V (e.hom (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap k n x))
